name: Pyromancer: Blessing of the Firelands raises Heat's effect 2 by 6 (#1923)
contract: #1923: Blessing of the Firelands 504397 effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 12 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, base 5 + 1 = +6, class mask C 0x40 = Heat 807389. ApplyEffectModifiers adds it to Heat's effect index 1 base (Unit.cpp:12147-12167), then the aura multiplies by its stack count, so each Heat stack carries 6 and Dragon Leap (806611) gains 6% per stack. No contract or script touches 807389 or 504397. Asserts the EFFECT2 modifier read for Heat is 6 (from 0), with Dragon Leap 806611 (outside mask C 0x40) as the control. The second effect (EFFECT3) has no slot on Heat and is not asserted. The per-stack Dragon Leap damage is not asserted because the report records no expected absolute damage. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.

steps.label: SETUP: no effect-2 modifier on Heat before Blessing
Blessing of the Firelands adds 6 to Heat's effect 2
Control: Dragon Leap gets no effect-2 modifier
